lunar_days.name: Artemis day
lunar_days.meaning: Sixth day associated with Artemis in a modern reconstruction.

recommendations.historical_practice: Unfavourable for planting and general fishing; good for taking eels in Te Papa compilation.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Review garden and fishing plans; assess local conditions. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: Not universally shared across iwi; no automatic Gregorian match. The batch calls this "lunar night 1"; Te Papa's page order is used here, and night numbers vary by iwi (some start the month at the full Moon).

recommendations.historical_practice: Reasonably good for crayfishing, eeling, planting, and shellfish collecting.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Consider planting and shore gathering where conditions and regulations permit. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: The batch calls this "lunar night 2"; Te Papa's page order is used here, and night numbers vary by iwi (some start the month at the full Moon).

recommendations.historical_practice: Crops bountiful and fishing favourable, but not eeling.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Compare fishing conditions and crop readiness. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: The batch calls this "full moon / night 14"; Te Papa's page order is used here, and night numbers vary by iwi (some start the month at the full Moon).

recommendations.historical_practice: Good for tuber beds, planting and fishing.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Prepare or plant tuber beds if local agronomic conditions suit. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: The batch calls this "lunar night 4"; Te Papa's page order is used here, and night numbers vary by iwi (some start the month at the full Moon).

recommendations.historical_practice: Unfavourable day; allow resources to recover.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Consider leaving a harvesting or fishing area undisturbed. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: The batch calls this "lunar night 16"; Te Papa's page order is used here, and night numbers vary by iwi (some start the month at the full Moon).

recommendations.historical_practice: Very productive for planting, fishing and eeling in the cited compilation.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Check locally suitable planting or fishing opportunities. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: The batch calls this "lunar night 26"; Te Papa's page order is used here, and night numbers vary by iwi (some start the month at the full Moon).

recommendations.historical_practice: Planting favourable, though tubers may remain small.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Consider sowing appropriate crops; note tuber caveat. (modern suggestion)

recommendations.historical_practice: Good day for planting.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Plan planting according to rainfall and soil moisture. (modern suggestion)

recommendations.historical_practice: Kū nights recommended for sweet potato, taro and banana in Handy and Handy.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Consider banana or root-crop planting, subject to local conditions. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: Historical ritual restrictions could override activity guidance.

recommendations.historical_practice: Kepelino cautions against planting bananas, gourds and sweet potatoes; good for fishing.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Compare alternatives to planting these crops; check fishing conditions. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: Tradition-specific exception to general Kū-night rule.

recommendations.historical_practice: Unfavourable for planting in cited sources.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Use the day for observation and maintenance rather than planting. (modern suggestion)

recommendations.historical_practice: Cited as a productive day as the ʻOle period ends.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Reassess conditions for field work. (modern suggestion)

recommendations.historical_practice: Kepelino describes a good planting day; Handy and Handy give a conflicting unfavourable assessment.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Show both interpretations; avoid a definitive recommendation. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: Conflicting primary-source traditions; must display disagreement.

recommendations.historical_practice: Planting possible but some crops may produce stems rather than fruit quickly.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Consider crop-specific cautions. (modern suggestion)

recommendations.historical_practice: Ancestral and royal-stool observance, recurring every six weeks.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Speak with elders or preserve family histories (modern reflection). (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: Date appears in Akan dictionary; independent guide describes it as calculated, not officially announced. Verify with Manhyia Palace before presenting as official.

recommendations.historical_practice: Household deities honoured at start of lunar month.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Reflect on household wellbeing or start-of-month goals. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: Modern reconstruction page, not itself an ancient primary source; crescent sighting is not astronomical conjunction. From a modern Hellenic reconstruction site, not an ancient text.

recommendations.historical_practice: Good Spirit household observance following Noumenia.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Reflect on care and stewardship of home. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: From a modern Hellenic reconstruction site, not an ancient text.

recommendations.historical_practice: Eke is one of four traditional market-day names; annual agricultural activities were organized through ritual and seasonal markers.
recommendations.modern_interpretation: Check local market scheduling and community observances; no universal Gregorian alignment. (modern suggestion)
recommendations.uncertainty: Order and alignment vary by community; study describes Nkwerre.

systems.name: Maramataka
systems.description: The Māori lunar calendar of named nights.
systems.uncertainty: Night names, their number and order differ among iwi; the numbered examples here are approximate reference positions from a composite account and are not authoritative for every iwi.
systems.month_rule: Iwi differ in how the month is counted: some begin it at the new Moon, some at the full Moon, and names, number and order of nights vary.

systems.name: Te Papa's maramataka activity sequence
systems.description: The planting, fishing and gathering guidance Te Papa gives night by night through the maramataka, numbered here in the order the page lists it.
systems.uncertainty: The numbers are the order of Te Papa's page, not established night numbers: several of the page's positions are fractional or repeated (2.5, 7.8, a second 12). Night names are given only where the page's text names them. Iwi differ in names, number and order. Do not use this as a conversion table.
systems.month_rule: Iwi differ in how the month is counted: some begin it at the new Moon, some at the full Moon, and names, number and order of nights vary.

cycles.name: Market week
cycles.regional_note: Order and alignment of the market days vary by community; the Nkwerre study describes one community.
